0022600035.text: The Orlando Magic host the Milwaukee Bucks in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A regular-season game, with Orlando at 3-7 overall, 0-4 at home, and on a one-game win streak, sitting 12th in the East and 3 games behind for fifth in the Southeast. Milwaukee comes in at 1-11, 15th in the East and 7 games back for fifth in the Central, on an eight-game losing streak. Orlando will be without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain), while Milwaukee is missing Myles Turner (rest) and has Ryan Rollins listed as day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, while the Magic won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 130-91 win in Milwaukee in their last meeting.
